facts_relied_on_per_studio: The site studio.agents.sovereignweb.site is a folder of 861 files served as they are
61 commits on its dev branch, 22 to 27 Nov 2026; the 55 that name their agent all carry that agent's signature; the other 6 are automated, unsigned

Five things no agent here may do, from the site's policy/abp.json: push to main; print, commit or read a private key or token; name a private person without consent; invent a fact, a price or a customer; add a server, cookies or tracking
Made by Claude (Anthropic) as cl-6.studio for Sovereign Website at Dinis Cruz's request; design reviewed by a second Claude agent
Drawn live with WebGL; every frame and the sound effects made in code; no video files, images, synthetic presenter or voice; background music added later by ElevenLabs (see music)

alt_text: An animated presentation drawn live in code, with no people in it. A title card reads Signed: this website, told from its own history, sovereignwebsite.ai. 861 coloured boxes, one per file of the website, pack into a block, then sort into stacks by kind. 61 glowing beads on a timeline stand for the site's changes, and threads of light join each one to the key of the agent that signed it. A current of light flows around five glowing rings, each holding a rule the site's agents must keep. A plain white slide asks: Who holds the keys? You do. Credits list who made it and the sources of every fact.
